nodes.name: Gmail Inbox
nodes.notes: General inbox polling: full message body, all non-self Inbox mail, no portfolio/demo subject filter.

nodes.name: Normalize Gmail Message
nodes.notes: Normalizes Gmail/IMAP output to the canonical email contract (section 6.5). HTML is stripped to text, quoted history and signatures are removed where safe, body is capped at 16000 chars, attachments are metadata-only (size capped at 10MB), and the body is treated as UNTRUSTED content. Idempotency key = mailbox:message-id.
